title: Watch: Trackside Friction Management Powered by ANATOMY Asset Intelligence ™
summary: L.B. Foster's PROTECTOR® and TGA3 trackside systems powered by ANATOMY Asset Intelligence™ cloud platform, deliver an optimized wheel-rail friction management (FM) program. Shaped by L.B. Foster’s industry expertise and decades of global customer experience, ANATOMY provides actionable insight that improves FM program ROI.
body_markdown:
A new animation video from L.B. Foster highlights how railroads can enhance their FM program and system performance by integrating[PROTECTOR and TGA3 trackside systems](https://lbfoster.com/rail/friction-management/friction-management-products/top-of-rail-and-wheel-tread-friction-management/trackside-top-of-rail-friction-management) with ANATOMY. It shows how a connected trackside FM program helps rail operators move beyond traditional maintenance approaches, giving greater visibility into program performance, consumable usage, and system health. Through continuous monitoring and data-driven insights, ANATOMY enables maintenance teams to proactively manage FM assets, improve uptime, and optimize field resources.


Watch the new video to see how L.B. Foster’s Trackside FM systems and ANATOMY Asset Intelligence help railroads maximize asset performance, increase operational efficiency, and support safer, more reliable rail operations.
